5_game_or_slate_date.DEFICIENCY: The K-board image does NOT visibly display a slate date. A date control is partially visible at the top-right but is cropped and illegible.
5_game_or_slate_date.corroboration_not_substitution: The three game-board images in the same upload are stamped 2026-07-27, and all 24 pitcher/matchup pairs on the K board correspond exactly to the frozen 7/27 slate (12 games). That is strong corroboration that this is the 7/27 board, but C5 requires the date be visible IN THE IMAGE, not supplied alongside it. Recorded as a failure of the stated test, not argued away.
5_game_or_slate_date.why_this_matters: C5 item 5 is the exact guard that classified KSIM-0727-U01 as STALE_PRIOR_SLATE. Reinterpreting it at the first moment it would block a capture, in the direction that unblocks it, is the move the protocol exists to prevent. E2 forbids amendment. This is referred to the protocol owner for adjudication.

6_main_line_status.note: The aggregator marks no line as the book's default/main. Per section 4 / D2 every pitcher is MAIN_LINE_UNRESOLVED: decisions may freeze and are scorable for outcome and CLV against the identical book and line, but simulated-main-line PLACEMENT comparison (C1) is EXCLUDED.

class_a_rejected_because: C2 - a single screenshot is not a scan cycle. No source was queried by us in A1 order; one image was received. Six books appearing inside one aggregator page does not make it a six-source cycle, and the prices are the aggregator's rendering of each book rather than the book's own response. Class B, therefore: may freeze executable decisions (C4/C8), may NEVER be presented as the hierarchy-selected primary comparison, and is never pooled with class-A results.
